title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: As Rajasekar slips into a coma, Rajeshwari compels Kanmani to divorce Anbu. Despite everyone's pleas, a humiliated Kanmani signs the divorce papers, leaving Anbu heartbroken.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri's visit sparks Shanmugam's fury, as he confronts and throws him out. Later, Vetri hides the truth from Karna about Abinaya's whereabouts.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Manjamalai reluctantly accepts Mayandi's request and joins the wedding shopping. The family happily selects wedding attire for Poongodi and Azhagar, leaving Mayandi content.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Concerned about her mother's illness, Malar seeks a way to meet her. Ragavan asks Bagyaraj to rush him to the hospital after his report shows elevated sugar and cholesterol.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha confides in Cheran about her parents' marriage pressure. Aneesh conceals the truth and assures Cheran that she is not being pressured.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu's revelation that Rohini named Manoj as her child's father shocks Manoj and Vijaya. Later, Vijaya decides to change Manoj's name to challenge Rohini.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Malar expresses her appreciation for Aishwarya's compassionate care towards Azhagar. Tamizhselvi's family ceremonially welcomes the new car and entrusts its keys to Meenatchi.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya shares an emotional call with Arjun and motivates him to unite with Madhu. Arjun is left stunned by Madhu's decision to terminate him.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira points out Kandhasamy's mistake in calculating food costs, leaving him furious and humiliated. Later, Indhira tends to Lakshmi after she suddenly faints from hunger.
